commit_scope: Two leftovers of #4134 named by review: the vision community directory still read the released interest routes, and the global navigation still listed the treasury page. The interest router, its service and the join form return (the vision pages join, lived and aligned all point at the directory); the treasury entry and the explore prefix leave the navigation.
evidence_refs: Review of #4134 (Codex, commit b7779cdb1): web/app/vision/community/page.tsx:93-105 fetches /api/interest/community and /api/interest/stats; web/components/site_header.tsx:42 lists /treasury in SECONDARY_NAV; web/tests/hati-grocery-layout.test.ts read the grocery page (that one was released before the merge).

Decision: the community directory is woven into the vision pages (join, lived, aligned link to /vision/community) the way the share door is, so interest comes back whole — router, interest_service, InterestForm and the join page's form, test_interest_registration — restored from 56e1bff2a; the cross-device claim in test_flow_core_api keeps its graduate start. The treasury navigation entry and the mobile nav's explore prefix are released.
Proof: app.main imports with 683 routes; test_interest_registration, test_flow_core_api and the suite-budget test pass (25); npx tsc --noEmit passes; vitest 141 passed.
